column1: # Cohort spec: CEREMONY A of the two-ceremony CTentacle factory-name chain.
# ONE ROW, DELIBERATELY.  0x004f07e0 and 0x004f0860 each want the name the other
# currently holds, so a single cohort containing both is refused - correctly - by
# this framework's noCycle and collision gates, and no non-mutating pre-flight
# check can clear both at once.  The chain is therefore staged as two one-row
# cohorts: A frees CTentacle__CreateTentacleAI, and only then does B's spec
# become satisfiable.  Ceremony A must complete in full - separate-process
# readback, POST backup, tracked refresh - before ceremony B's gates run.
# Do NOT merge these two specs, and do NOT relax noCycle to make one cohort pass;
# an ordered/staged rename is a reviewed framework extension, not a gate to drop.
# Every metric below was MEASURED by this framework's own `census` mode on a
# (byte-identical to live db.18622), not carried over from prose.
# postFrozenDigest is deliberately NOT pinned: `name` is one of the 20 frozen
# columns, so the target row legitimately moves it, and the value cannot be
# computed outside the framework.  The framework's own POST collateral census
# still compares every frozen column on all 8,329 rows.
